-- Create the database master key through a secure deployment process; never commit its password.

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL cred_nisk
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'



CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_silver
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://awdatastorage1.blob.core.windows.net/silver',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_nisk
)


CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE source_gold
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://awdatastorage1.blob.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_nisk
)

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT format_parquet
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)



--- create external table gold.extablea

create external table gold.extsales
with(
    Location='extsales',
    DATA_SOURCE= source_gold,
    FILE_FORMAT= format_parquet
)
as 
select * from gold.sales


select * from gold.extsales
